title: From Strength To Strength
summary:
Bullish medium-term outlook for Aframax and LR2 tankers
Aframax tankers have been one of the key beneficiaries of the conflict in Ukraine. Western sanctions on Russia closed off many of the short-haul destinations for Russian crude oil and refined product exports. This has increased the average distance over which Russian oil needs to be transported.
